# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.

instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.

###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.

(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

the highlights in our Annual Report.

# Culture Diagnostics, Simplified

From collection to culture, making it easier to do your best work

[ SHOP ALL PRODUCTS ][37]

## Shop by Category

## Clinical Microbiology

Reliable culture-based solutions for HAI detection, routine screening, and pathogen identification.

## [Explore products][38]

## Veterinary Microbiology

Prepared culture media and self-contained diagnostic devices for efficient in-clinic and field
testing.

## [Explore products][39]

## Food & Environmental Microbiology

Pre-plated media and all-in-one diagnostic solutions designed for sample collection, transport, and
analysis—whether in the field, a processing facility, or the lab.

## [Explore products][40]

## Time-Tested, Diagnostics-Proven

For clinicians, veterinarians, and laboratory professionals, our InTray® and InPouch® systems
streamline sample collection, incubation, and pathogen detection into a self-contained format,
reducing contamination risk and eliminating unnecessary transfers.

## InTray®

A self-contained culture system that integrates specimen collection, selective media incubation, and
direct microscopic analysis—all within a sealed cassette. Designed for point-of-care and laboratory
use, InTray® minimizes handling while enabling reliable pathogen identification.

[ LEARN MORE ][41]

## InPouch®

A resealable culture-based diagnostic system combining sample collection, transport, incubation, and
microscopic observation in one device. InPouch® is engineered for clinical, veterinary, and
field-based testing, providing a safe, efficient, and contamination-resistant alternative to
traditional culture.

For clinicians, veterinarians, and laboratory professionals, our InTray® and InPouch® systems
streamline sample collection, incubation, and pathogen detection into a self-contained format,
reducing contamination risk and eliminating unnecessary transfers.

direct microscopic analysis—all within a sealed cassette. Designed for point-of-care and laboratory

traditional culture.

Behind every major project are people most of us never see. The engineers, technicians, project
leaders and technical specialists powering the electricity in our homes, the materials we depend on,
the infrastructure that connects us, and the essential industries we depend on every day.


For over[50 years][48], Brunel has helped the world's leading businesses find and mobilise
specialist talent for some of the most critical projects and industries on the planet, wherever, and
whenever, they're needed.

Whether you're delivering a major project, scaling operations across borders, or solving your next
workforce challenge, our global recruitment specialists are here to help you find the people who
make it possible.

# CHALLENGE TB

September 4, 2019

## [Challenge TB Closeout][1]

[india]After 5 years of work, the Challenge TB project is coming to a close.

 
To highlight the impact of the project and to celebrate its achievements, a closeout event will be
held at the Union Conference in Hyderabad, India.

 
The event will be chaired by Prof. Frank Cobelens – Professor of Epidemiology and Control of
Poverty-Related Infectious Diseases, University of Amsterdam and Dr. Tereza Kasaeva – Director of
the World Health Organization Global TB Program.

May 15, 2019

## [Technical Briefs][2]

[brief]Challenge TB has developed numerous implementation and technical briefs which highlight the
project’s technical approaches, results, and lessons from our work in TB across 23 countries over
the last 5 years.

 

In order to share the project’s experiences and insights with as wide an audience as possible, these
technical documents are all available to [download][3], allowing everyone to learn about our impact,
and continue the fight to end the TB epidemic.

December 12, 2018

## [New Guide on Drug-Safety Monitoring][4]

[aDSM]With recent developments in drug-resistant TB (DR-TB) treatment, particularly the approval for
use of the new drugs, bedaquiline and delamanid ahead of the completion of Phase III trials, there
is a need for early and systematic detection, management, recording, and reporting of any adverse
events that may occur in patients who are prescribed these medications.

 
To meet this need we have published a new guide on [Active drug safety monitoring and management
(aDSM)][5].

 
This technical guidance document introduces the concept of aDSM for new drugs and regimens used in
the treatment of drug-resistant TB patients, outlines the definitions related to aDSM, the agreed
essential activities, and the key steps in implementing aDSM in patients on treatment.

# Infinite Diagnostics
# Our Mobile Blood Draw Services

We bring the lab to your doorstep. Our certified mobile phlebotomists handle the entire process
comfortably in your home, office, or living facility.

[Book here
][9]

## Your Health Your Comfort
## Professional At-home blood draw Delivered to Your Door

Skip the stressful clinic trips and crowded waiting rooms. We bring certified phlebotomy care
directly to your living room, providing safe, accurate, and gentle blood draws where your family
feels most secure. Whether it is a routine test for a senior parent, a gentle poke for a newborn, or
an accessible solution for individuals with disabilities, we make lab work completely effortless for
the people who matter most to you.

Safe and professional at-home blood draw brought directly to your door.

Nationally Certified & Trusted Carey
Our phlebotomist are fully certified by the National Healthcareer Association (NHA) as a Certified
Phlebotomy Technician (CPT). We strictly adhere to all NHA, OSHA, and CLIA safety standards to
ensure a seamless, professional, and painless mobile blood draw in the comfort of your home or
office.

Office: +1 (860) 351-1625

Fax: +1 (000) 000-0000

info@infinitediagnosticslab.com

### Infinite Diagnostics is an independent, mobile blood draw specimen collection service. We
### provide professional phlebotomy collection, processing, and delivery services only. We are not a
### medical laboratory, we do not analyze specimens, and our staff does not provide medical
### diagnoses, treatment advice, or consultation.

At Infinite Diagnostics, your health, comfort, and peace of mind are our absolute priorities. We
maintain the highest clinical standards for infection control and biohazard management.

Ваше здоровье – наш главный приоритет. Мы используем высокоточное оборудование и передовые методы
диагностики, чтобы обеспечить эффективное лечение и профилактику.

* Устранение причин, а не маскировка симптомов
* 60+ врачей экспертного уровня с рейтингом 5★

Современное оборудование
* Биоимпедансный анализатор «Медасс» – оценка состава тела и обмена веществ

National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) – a joint venture company of Govt of India and
States of Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh is mandated for implementing the Namo Bharat
project across the National Capital Region, ensuring a balanced and sustainable urban development
through better connectivity and access.

Improve quality of life of people by providing equitable, fast, reliable, safe, comfortable,
efficient and sustainable mobility solutions enabling economic development of NCR.

Team NCRTC is working day and night to provide the people of NCR Regional Rapid Transit System, a
next generation green mobility solution. It will significantly reduce pollution and congestion in
the region. Transformational projects like RRTS are part of long-term strategic intervention of
Governments towards an environmentally sustainable development of NCR.

Namo Bharat is a new, dedicated, high speed, high capacity, comfortable commuter service connecting
regional nodes in NCR.
It is different from conventional Railway as it will provide reliable, high frequency, point to
point regional travel at high speed along dedicated path way. Namo Bharat is also different from
metro as it caters to passengers looking to travel relatively longer distance with fewer stops and
at higher speed.

## [गति से प्रगति][224]

National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) – a joint venture company of Govt of India and
States of Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh is mandated for implementing the Namo Bharat
project across the National Capital Region, ensuring a balanced and sustainable urban development
through better connectivity and access.

National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) – a joint venture company of Govt of India and
States of Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh is mandated for implementing the Namo Bharat
project across the National Capital Region, ensuring a balanced and sustainable urban development
through better connectivity and access.

## Our Vision

Improve quality of life of people by providing equitable, fast, reliable, safe, comfortable,
efficient and sustainable mobility solutions enabling economic development of NCR.
[ KNOW MORE ][225]

## From Our MD

Team NCRTC is working day and night to provide the people of NCR Regional Rapid Transit System, a
next generation green mobility solution. It will significantly reduce pollution and congestion in
the region. Transformational projects like RRTS are part of long-term strategic intervention of
Governments towards an environmentally sustainable development of NCR.
[ KNOW MORE ][226]

## Namo Bharat Project

Namo Bharat is a new, dedicated, high speed, high capacity, comfortable commuter service connecting
regional nodes in NCR.
It is different from conventional Railway as it will provide reliable, high frequency, point to
point regional travel at high speed along dedicated path way. Namo Bharat is also different from
metro as it caters to passengers looking to travel relatively longer distance with fewer stops and
at higher speed.

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

**ZooKeys** is a peer-reviewed, open access, online and print, rapidly published journal, launched
to support free exchange of ideas, data and information in all branches of Zoology. It is one of the
most dynamic, innovative  and technologically advanced scholarly journals in its field. Zookeys was
the first to implement semantic tagging and enhancements of content since the publication of its
issue 50 in 2010. Currently, ZooKeys takes second place in the Index of Organism Names among the top
10 journals publishing the greatest number of new taxa in Zoology.
